note: For each practice: a short label and a sentence that makes sense on its own (the rubric's sentences point at one another: "that priority", "those records"). The detailed report and the website print these; the rubric's sentence stays the standard the judge applies. The 24 for Technology and data are from the approved mock (26 Nov 2026); the rest are drafts written the same night. Harsha checks them against the rubric.

AIQIF-C1.1.F1.label: A plan with an AI priority
AIQIF-C1.1.F1.looked_for: An approved plan for the institution names a digital or AI priority.

AIQIF-C1.1.F2.label: An owner for the priority
AIQIF-C1.1.F2.looked_for: A person or office is responsible for the digital or AI priority in the plan.

AIQIF-C1.1.A1.label: An AI initiative at work
AIQIF-C1.1.A1.looked_for: Records show an AI initiative running in a named part of the institution.

AIQIF-C1.1.A2.label: Decisions on AI initiatives
AIQIF-C1.1.A2.looked_for: A review of the institution's AI initiatives records a decision about one of them.

AIQIF-C1.1.O1.label: Results against objectives
AIQIF-C1.1.O1.looked_for: A review compares an AI initiative's measured result with the objective set for it.

AIQIF-C1.1.O2.label: Effect of a decision
AIQIF-C1.1.O2.looked_for: A later record judges what a decision about an AI initiative changed.

AIQIF-C1.2.F1.label: A body that decides on AI
AIQIF-C1.2.F1.looked_for: A committee or body has authority over digital or AI decisions.

AIQIF-C1.2.F2.label: A route for escalating
AIQIF-C1.2.F2.looked_for: There is a set route for taking a digital or AI decision to a higher level.

AIQIF-C1.2.A1.label: A dated AI decision
AIQIF-C1.2.A1.looked_for: A dated decision of a governing body is about an actual use of AI.

AIQIF-C1.2.A2.label: Follow-up on actions
AIQIF-C1.2.A2.looked_for: An action a governing body assigned has a recorded follow-up.

AIQIF-C1.2.O1.label: Review of governance
AIQIF-C1.2.O1.looked_for: A review judges how well governance worked, using a real incident or delivery result.

AIQIF-C1.2.O2.label: Check of a revised rule
AIQIF-C1.2.O2.looked_for: A follow-up checks that a revised governance rule has been put into practice.

AIQIF-C1.3.F1.label: Resources committed
AIQIF-C1.3.F1.looked_for: Money or other resources are committed to computing, teaching or innovation capacity.

AIQIF-C1.3.F2.label: Who the resources serve
AIQIF-C1.3.F2.looked_for: An allocation decision names the group or function the resources are for.

AIQIF-C1.3.A1.label: Resources against need
AIQIF-C1.3.A1.looked_for: A review compares the resources committed with a named need they were meant to meet.

AIQIF-C1.3.A2.label: Response to a shortfall
AIQIF-C1.3.A2.looked_for: A decision on resources responds to a recorded shortfall in capacity.

AIQIF-C1.3.O1.label: Cost against benefit
AIQIF-C1.3.O1.looked_for: A review compares what resources cost with a measured benefit or capacity result.

AIQIF-C1.3.O2.label: Effect of a change in funding
AIQIF-C1.3.O2.looked_for: A follow-up judges what a change in how resources were allocated achieved.

AIQIF-C1.4.F1.label: A way to introduce new tools
AIQIF-C1.4.F1.looked_for: There is a set process for introducing a digital service or teaching tool.

AIQIF-C1.4.F2.label: Support for users
AIQIF-C1.4.F2.looked_for: Users of a digital service or teaching tool have a named contact for support.

AIQIF-C1.4.A1.label: Repeated use
AIQIF-C1.4.A1.looked_for: Usage records show a digital service or tool used again and again where it was introduced.

AIQIF-C1.4.A2.label: Help with adoption problems
AIQIF-C1.4.A2.looked_for: A support action responds to a recorded barrier to taking up a service or tool.

AIQIF-C1.4.O1.label: Adoption against a target
AIQIF-C1.4.O1.looked_for: A review compares how widely a service or tool is used with a stated target.

AIQIF-C1.4.O2.label: Effect of an adoption change
AIQIF-C1.4.O2.looked_for: A follow-up judges what a change to adoption or to the user experience achieved.

AIQIF-C2.1.F1.label: Guidance on AI use
AIQIF-C2.1.F1.looked_for: Guidance in force at the institution deals with the use of AI explicitly.

AIQIF-C2.1.F2.label: Limits on unsafe use
AIQIF-C2.1.F2.looked_for: Written guidance on AI sets a limit on unsafe or inappropriate use of AI.

AIQIF-C2.1.A1.label: Policy checked at start
AIQIF-C2.1.A1.looked_for: When an AI tool is brought in or a user is set up, a check applies the AI policy.

AIQIF-C2.1.A2.label: Exceptions reviewed
AIQIF-C2.1.A2.looked_for: A review of how AI is actually used records what was decided about an exception to the policy.

AIQIF-C2.1.O1.label: Policy reviewed after an incident
AIQIF-C2.1.O1.looked_for: A review of the AI policy looks at a real incident or audit finding.

AIQIF-C2.1.O2.label: Test of a revised rule
AIQIF-C2.1.O2.looked_for: A follow-up tests whether a revised rule on responsible AI use works.

AIQIF-C2.2.F1.label: Owner for personal data
AIQIF-C2.2.F1.looked_for: A person or office is responsible for personal or sensitive data the institution holds.

AIQIF-C2.2.F2.label: Access control
AIQIF-C2.2.F2.looked_for: A written procedure controls who can get into an information system that holds such data.

AIQIF-C2.2.A1.label: Risk assessment of an AI use
AIQIF-C2.2.A1.looked_for: A risk assessment covers a named use of AI that is in operation.

AIQIF-C2.2.A2.label: Risk decision on a change
AIQIF-C2.2.A2.looked_for: A recorded risk decision responds to a change in access or in a supplier.

AIQIF-C2.2.O1.label: Risk against a standard
AIQIF-C2.2.O1.looked_for: A risk review compares the exposure found with a stated risk standard.

AIQIF-C2.2.O2.label: Test of a fix
AIQIF-C2.2.O2.looked_for: A follow-up tests whether a fix put in place to reduce a risk works.

AIQIF-C2.3.F1.label: List of AI tools
AIQIF-C2.3.F1.looked_for: A list names the AI services and tools in use.

AIQIF-C2.3.F2.label: Owner for each AI tool

AIQIF-C2.3.A1.label: Testing before release
AIQIF-C2.3.A1.looked_for: A record shows an AI service was evaluated when it was released or changed.

AIQIF-C2.3.A2.label: Where the data came from

AIQIF-C2.3.O1.label: Monitoring after release
AIQIF-C2.3.O1.looked_for: Monitoring after release compares how an AI service behaves with a stated standard.

AIQIF-C2.3.O2.label: Withdrawal tested
AIQIF-C2.3.O2.looked_for: An exercise to roll back or retire an AI service records what happened.

AIQIF-C2.4.F1.label: A person can step in
AIQIF-C2.4.F1.looked_for: For an AI use that affects people, there is a set way for a person to step in.

AIQIF-C2.4.F2.label: A way to appeal
AIQIF-C2.4.F2.looked_for: People affected by an AI use have a way to report an error or appeal.

AIQIF-C2.4.A1.label: Human oversight on record
AIQIF-C2.4.A1.looked_for: A record shows a person overseeing an actual AI use that affects people.

AIQIF-C2.4.A2.label: Test for failure or bias
AIQIF-C2.4.A2.looked_for: A test examines a named failure or fairness risk in an AI use that affects people.

AIQIF-C2.4.O1.label: Independent review
AIQIF-C2.4.O1.looked_for: Someone not involved in the decision reviews a harm or oversight result.

AIQIF-C2.4.O2.label: Test of an oversight change
AIQIF-C2.4.O2.looked_for: A follow-up tests what a change to human oversight achieved.

AIQIF-C3.1.F1.label: AI in an approved syllabus
AIQIF-C3.1.F1.looked_for: An approved syllabus includes real content on AI or machine learning.

AIQIF-C3.1.F2.label: A learning objective for AI
AIQIF-C3.1.F2.looked_for: A syllabus states a learning objective for its AI or machine learning content.

AIQIF-C3.1.A1.label: AI content taught
AIQIF-C3.1.A1.looked_for: Teaching records show AI content taught to a named programme or group.

AIQIF-C3.1.A2.label: AI learning assessed
AIQIF-C3.1.A2.looked_for: Marked student work shows what students learned against a stated AI criterion.

AIQIF-C3.1.O1.label: Course review of AI learning
AIQIF-C3.1.O1.looked_for: A course review compares what students learned about AI with the objective.

AIQIF-C3.1.O2.label: Effect of a curriculum change
AIQIF-C3.1.O2.looked_for: A later assessment judges what a change to the AI curriculum achieved.

AIQIF-C3.2.F1.label: An AI literacy offer
AIQIF-C3.2.F1.looked_for: A course or activity teaching basic AI literacy is defined.

AIQIF-C3.2.F2.label: Open to a named group

AIQIF-C3.2.A1.label: Literacy in a discipline

AIQIF-C3.2.A2.label: Help for a discipline's gap

AIQIF-C3.2.O1.label: Literacy assessed by discipline
AIQIF-C3.2.O1.looked_for: An assessment reports how well learners in a named discipline understand AI.

AIQIF-C3.2.O2.label: Effect of targeted support

AIQIF-C3.3.F1.label: An AI-supported activity

AIQIF-C3.3.O1.label: Results against a baseline

AIQIF-C3.3.O2.label: Effect of a design change

AIQIF-C4.1.O1.looked_for: An assessment compares faculty AI literacy with a stated standard of competence.

AIQIF-C4.1.O2.looked_for: A later assessment judges what a change to faculty AI learning achieved.

AIQIF-C4.3.A2.label: Quality check
AIQIF-C4.3.A2.looked_for: A quality check evaluates academic work done with AI.

AIQIF-C4.3.O1.label: Results against a baseline
AIQIF-C4.3.O1.looked_for: An evaluation compares quality, time saved or research results with a stated baseline.

AIQIF-C7.2.F1.label: An AI centre or function
AIQIF-C7.2.F1.looked_for: An AI centre, or AI innovation work spread across departments, has a set remit.

AIQIF-C7.2.F2.label: Projects or mentoring offered
AIQIF-C7.2.F2.looked_for: An AI centre or innovation function offers project support or mentoring.

AIQIF-C7.2.A1.label: A project or mentee helped
AIQIF-C7.2.A1.looked_for: A record shows an AI project or mentoring engagement the centre supported.

AIQIF-C7.2.A2.label: A decision from a service review
AIQIF-C7.2.A2.looked_for: A review of the centre's service records a decision based on how it was used.

AIQIF-C7.2.O1.label: Benefit against the objective
AIQIF-C7.2.O1.looked_for: A review judges an output or benefit of the AI centre against its objective.

AIQIF-C7.2.O2.label: Effect of a service change
AIQIF-C7.2.O2.looked_for: A follow-up judges what a change to the centre's service achieved.

AIQIF-C7.3.F1.label: Funding, patent or incubation support
AIQIF-C7.3.F1.looked_for: Funding, patent or incubation support is open to eligible AI projects.

AIQIF-C7.3.F2.label: How to apply
AIQIF-C7.3.F2.looked_for: A contact or application route lets an AI project reach funding, patent or incubation support.

AIQIF-C7.3.A1.label: Support used by a project
AIQIF-C7.3.A1.looked_for: A project record shows an AI project using funding, patent or incubation support.

AIQIF-C7.3.A2.label: A funding decision
AIQIF-C7.3.A2.looked_for: A review records a funding or development decision about a named AI project.

AIQIF-C7.3.O1.label: Progress against a milestone
AIQIF-C7.3.O1.looked_for: A review judges an AI project's verified progress against a stated milestone.

AIQIF-C7.3.O2.label: Effect of a support change
AIQIF-C7.3.O2.looked_for: A follow-up judges what a change to project support achieved.

AIQIF-C7.4.F1.label: A work plan with a partner
AIQIF-C7.4.F1.looked_for: A work plan for a collaboration sets out real AI research or application work.

AIQIF-C7.4.F2.label: The partner's part
AIQIF-C7.4.F2.looked_for: A partner in a collaboration is given responsibility for planned AI work.

AIQIF-C7.4.A1.label: AI work delivered with a partner
AIQIF-C7.4.A1.looked_for: A record shows AI work actually done with a partner, beyond signing an agreement.

AIQIF-C7.4.A2.label: Partner or beneficiary feedback
AIQIF-C7.4.A2.looked_for: Feedback from a partner or beneficiary judges a piece of AI work that was delivered.

AIQIF-C7.4.O1.label: Benefit against the objective
AIQIF-C7.4.O1.looked_for: A review judges knowledge transfer or a benefit to others against a stated objective.

AIQIF-C7.4.O2.label: Effect of a collaboration change
AIQIF-C7.4.O2.looked_for: A follow-up judges what a change to a collaboration achieved.

AIQIF-C8.1.F1.label: A digital service with a purpose
AIQIF-C8.1.F1.looked_for: A digital service of the institution has a stated purpose.

AIQIF-C8.1.F2.label: An owner for the service
AIQIF-C8.1.F2.looked_for: A person or office is responsible for a digital service of the institution.

AIQIF-C8.1.A1.label: AI used in a service
AIQIF-C8.1.A1.looked_for: Operating records show AI used repeatedly in a named service, such as admissions or examinations.

AIQIF-C8.1.A2.label: Problems monitored
AIQIF-C8.1.A2.looked_for: A monitoring record looks at a problem in an AI-supported service.

AIQIF-C8.1.O1.label: Benefit against a baseline
AIQIF-C8.1.O1.looked_for: An evaluation compares a service's benefit with a stated baseline, saying what limits the comparison.

AIQIF-C8.1.O2.label: Effect of a workflow change
AIQIF-C8.1.O2.looked_for: A follow-up tests what a change to a workflow or control achieved.

AIQIF-C8.2.F1.label: AI work with industry planned
AIQIF-C8.2.F1.looked_for: A work plan with an industry partner sets out an AI-related activity.

AIQIF-C8.2.F2.label: What the partner adds
AIQIF-C8.2.F2.looked_for: An activity with an industry partner says what it adds to skills, curriculum or projects.

AIQIF-C8.2.A1.label: Activity delivered
AIQIF-C8.2.A1.looked_for: A record shows an AI-related activity delivered with an industry partner.

AIQIF-C8.2.A2.label: Partner's contribution reviewed
AIQIF-C8.2.A2.looked_for: A review judges what an industry partner delivered for skills, projects or opportunities.

AIQIF-C8.2.O1.label: Partnership against its objective
AIQIF-C8.2.O1.looked_for: A partnership review judges an output or outcome against a stated objective.

AIQIF-C8.2.O2.label: Effect of an agreed change
AIQIF-C8.2.O2.looked_for: A follow-up judges what a change agreed with the partner achieved.

AIQIF-C8.3.F1.label: A pathway to AI jobs or ventures
AIQIF-C8.3.F1.looked_for: A route to employment, enterprise or workforce roles deals with AI skills explicitly.

AIQIF-C8.3.F2.label: A way in
AIQIF-C8.3.F2.looked_for: An opportunity or referral route connects eligible people to an AI jobs or enterprise pathway.

AIQIF-C8.3.A1.label: A participant placed
AIQIF-C8.3.A1.looked_for: A verified record links a participant in an AI pathway to a job, opportunity or venture.

AIQIF-C8.3.A2.label: Participation and results
AIQIF-C8.3.A2.looked_for: A review looks at how taking part in an AI pathway relates to the results seen.

AIQIF-C8.3.O1.label: Results against an objective
AIQIF-C8.3.O1.looked_for: A review judges verified progression or enterprise results against a stated objective.

AIQIF-C8.3.O2.label: Effect of a pathway change
AIQIF-C8.3.O2.looked_for: A follow-up judges what a change to the set of pathways achieved.

AIQIF-C8.4.F1.label: An outcome for an AI initiative
AIQIF-C8.4.F1.looked_for: A named AI initiative has a clearly stated intended outcome.

AIQIF-C8.4.F2.label: A way to measure it
AIQIF-C8.4.F2.looked_for: A method for measuring an AI initiative's outcome is set out before it is measured.

AIQIF-C8.4.A1.label: Results against a baseline
AIQIF-C8.4.A1.looked_for: Recorded results compare an AI initiative's outcome with a stated baseline, by a stated method.

AIQIF-C8.4.A2.label: Other explanations considered
AIQIF-C8.4.A2.looked_for: A review considers another explanation for the results, or a possible harm.

AIQIF-C8.4.O1.label: Benefit within stated limits
AIQIF-C8.4.O1.looked_for: A measurement review judges the benefit of an AI initiative, saying what limits the finding.

AIQIF-C8.4.O2.label: Effect of a change
AIQIF-C8.4.O2.looked_for: A later measurement judges what a change to an AI initiative achieved.

AIQIF-C9.1.F1.label: Review with set indicators
AIQIF-C9.1.F1.looked_for: The institution reviews itself using a set of defined indicators.

AIQIF-C9.1.F2.label: An owner for the review
AIQIF-C9.1.F2.looked_for: A person or office is responsible for producing the indicator-based review.

AIQIF-C9.1.A1.label: Repeated, traceable assessment
AIQIF-C9.1.A1.looked_for: A repeated self-assessment uses evidence that can be traced and calculations that can be repeated.

AIQIF-C9.1.A2.label: Changes kept apart
AIQIF-C9.1.A2.looked_for: A change record separates changes in the evidence from changes in the method.

AIQIF-C9.1.O1.label: Results used to set priorities
AIQIF-C9.1.O1.looked_for: A review uses the self-assessment's results to judge an improvement priority.

AIQIF-C9.1.O2.label: Effect of a method change
AIQIF-C9.1.O2.looked_for: A follow-up judges what a change to the measurement method achieved.

AIQIF-C9.2.F1.label: An index of evidence
AIQIF-C9.2.F1.looked_for: An index lists the records used as evidence in assessments.

AIQIF-C9.2.F2.label: A keeper of records
AIQIF-C9.2.F2.looked_for: A person or office is responsible for keeping the evidence records.

AIQIF-C9.2.A1.label: Findings traced to sources
AIQIF-C9.2.A1.looked_for: A sample of assessment findings can be traced to the standard and the passage behind each.

AIQIF-C9.2.A2.label: Corrections on record
AIQIF-C9.2.A2.looked_for: When evidence is corrected, the earlier record and the reason for the change are kept.

AIQIF-C9.2.O1.label: Traceability audited
AIQIF-C9.2.O1.looked_for: An audit checks traceability against a written checking procedure.

AIQIF-C9.2.O2.label: Effect of an improvement
AIQIF-C9.2.O2.looked_for: A follow-up measures what an improvement to the evidence process achieved.

AIQIF-C9.3.F1.label: Watching for outside changes
AIQIF-C9.3.F1.looked_for: A process keeps watch on changes in accreditation, curriculum or technology.

AIQIF-C9.3.F2.label: A review schedule
AIQIF-C9.3.F2.looked_for: A schedule sets when outside changes are reviewed.

AIQIF-C9.3.A1.label: A change acted on
AIQIF-C9.3.A1.looked_for: A change review names a standard affected by an outside change.

AIQIF-C9.3.A2.label: Earlier results kept
AIQIF-C9.3.A2.looked_for: A new assessment keeps the earlier result and explains what changed.

AIQIF-C9.3.O1.label: Timeliness reviewed
AIQIF-C9.3.O1.looked_for: A review judges how quickly a relevant outside change was noticed.

AIQIF-C9.3.O2.label: Effect of a monitoring change
AIQIF-C9.3.O2.looked_for: A follow-up judges what a change to how changes are watched achieved.

AIQIF-C9.4.F1.label: Feedback on an initiative
AIQIF-C9.4.F1.looked_for: Feedback is collected on a digital or learning initiative.

AIQIF-C9.4.F2.label: Owners for follow-up actions
AIQIF-C9.4.F2.looked_for: A register of follow-up actions names who owns each action.

AIQIF-C9.4.A1.label: Initiative reviewed by users
AIQIF-C9.4.A1.looked_for: A user acceptance or outcome review judges a named initiative in use.

AIQIF-C9.4.A2.label: Corrective action checked
AIQIF-C9.4.A2.looked_for: A corrective action has a recorded check that it was completed.

AIQIF-C9.4.O1.label: Result of a change
AIQIF-C9.4.O1.looked_for: A review judges the result of a change made in response to feedback.

AIQIF-C9.4.O2.label: A lesson applied
AIQIF-C9.4.O2.looked_for: A later initiative clearly applies a lesson from an earlier review.
